addGame.text: Any game file of the platform (see Settings → Game files), a .zip, or a disc image: .bin + .cue, CloneCD (.ccd + .img + .sub) or .ecm, turned into one .img. Add a cover (PNG, JPG, WEBP), or one is drawn for you. Tags are set afterwards in the table.
addGame.title: Add a game

delete.text: Tick games and click “Delete selected”, or use “Delete game file” in Details. The game file is deleted from the card, and its CSV entry can be removed too. The cover and the saves are kept: delete the cover with “Delete image” in Details.
delete.title: Delete games

edit.text: Double-click a game’s title, short name or tags. Enter saves, Esc cancels. The CSV is updated; a new title also renames the game file, its cover and its saves.
edit.title: Edit right in the table

platform.text: Pick a platform card on the main screen, the “Platform” list or “Card contents”. Its games, covers and filelist.csv then open in the table.
platform.title: Choose a platform

sdCard.text: Insert the console’s card and click “Select SD card”. Choose the root of the card: the folder that holds the platform folders (FC, GBA, PS…).
sdCard.title: Choose the SD card

search.text: The search field looks through every platform folder of the card: titles, short names, file names and tags. ↑ / ↓ choose a result, Enter opens its platform and selects the game.
search.title: Search all platforms

tour.waitingForCard: The tour will go on once you choose the SD card.
